## Summary

- 

## Change Type

- [ ] User-facing feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation or contributor workflow
- [ ] Maintenance or refactor

## User Impact

What workflow gets better, safer, or easier because of this change?

## Linked Issue or Discussion

Link the issue, discussion, or `good first issue` this closes or follows up. Use `Closes #...` when the pull request should close an issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Manual app check on macOS, if UI, reader, packaging, or file-open behavior changed

## Screenshots or Recording

For UI changes, add a screenshot or short recording. For non-UI changes, write "Not applicable".

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change stays focused on one user-visible improvement, bug fix, or maintenance task
- [ ] User-facing behavior is covered by tests or documented manual verification
- [ ] README, docs, or changelog are updated when behavior changes
- [ ] Project Status is updated if platform support, release distribution, trust caveats, or project scope changed
- [ ] Governance Guide is checked before discussion-first changes such as cloud sync, telemetry, CHM authoring, broad platform support, signing, notarization, or release distribution changes
- [ ] Performance-sensitive changes include `npm run benchmark:chm` output or explain why it is not applicable
- [ ] Accessibility-sensitive changes include keyboard-only or VoiceOver verification, or explain why it is not applicable
